name: MERRIAL
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of Now the Day Is Over (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/Now_the_Day_Is_Over/, Now_the_Day_Is_Over.xml, whose rights line reads “WORDS: Sabine Baring-Gould, pub.1865. MUSIC: “Merrial”; Joseph Barnby, 1868. Public Domain.”); only the tune was taken, not the harmony. Its opening agrees with hymnary.org's incipit 55555 56656 76111 (https://hymnary.org/tune/merrial_barnby) and CCEH's ssssss|llsltld|ddtlss (https://www.ccel.org/cceh/0009/x000917.htm). No hand fixes. Barnby's dates (1838–1896) and the year 1868 are from the hymnary.org tune page.
